ideas.summary: Use specs/001-quartermaster/tasks.md as the only implementation ledger.
ideas.rationale: Project-owned instructions explicitly reject earlier task lists and require named verification evidence.

ideas.summary: Link canonical Git and user skill sources into provenance groups instead of copying or importing deployed harness state.
ideas.rationale: The current deployed state is not a desirable baseline. Seven canonical sources now feed a clean first-party and third-party library with rollback evidence.

ideas.summary: Promote Quartermaster to a real /home/cheta/code/quartermaster root after migration gates pass.
ideas.rationale: The compatibility link restores operation but the permanent workspace pattern requires one visible real project root.

ideas.summary: Catalog curated specialist skills without deploying them to every harness.
ideas.details: The initial specialist source contributes 202 catalog entries and remains outside the active core loadout.
ideas.rationale: Search and recommendation need broad visibility; runtime context should remain deliberately narrow.

ideas.summary: Use explicit loadouts and refuse deployment when a harness has no active loadout.
ideas.details: The current core loadout contains 29 custom skills across 12 profiles, includes verified Imagegen, and excludes Damage Control pending reconciliation.
ideas.rationale: Explicit selection prevents the clean replacement system from inheriting an accidental deployed state.
